title: Question Presentation
description: Presentation-safe representation of a single clarification question for Teams/Copilot rendering.

key.description: Stable answer key in format fieldId::slotType::slotIndex::xmlLang.

label.description: Human-readable field label from registry. Verbatim — never rewritten.

question.description: Question text from registry. Verbatim — never rewritten.

required.description: Whether this field must be answered for session completion.

currentValue.description: Prior-season value from blueprint. Null when field was not set.

replayCritical.description: When true, changing this value triggers a replay safety warning.

xmlLang.description: Locale tag for localized fields (e.g. 'x-default', 'en'). Null for non-localized.

slotIndex.description: Zero-based slot position. Null for campaign (singleton).

currentGroup.description: Group name this question belongs to.

completedInGroup.description: Number of validly answered questions in this group.

choices.description: Allowed values for enum fields. Null for free-form fields.

validationHints.description: Human-readable hints derived from the registry validation spec.

isRetry.description: True when re-asking due to a previous validation failure.

validationErrors.description: Validation errors from the previous attempt.

priorRawValue.description: The rejected raw value from the previous attempt. Null on first attempt.
